_comment: Mandate hook. Merge the 'hooks' key into ~/.claude/settings.json or <project>/.claude/settings.json. If a 'hooks' key already exists, merge the PreToolUse array rather than replacing it. Only one rule here on purpose: Claude Code's Auto Mode already blocks destructive commands (git reset --hard, git clean, rm -rf, teardown). It does not catch writing into another project, because that action is only wrong relative to what was asked.
